account.description: Money account: The account buy-ins are taken from and prizes and refunds are paid to.

minBuyIn.description: Lowest buy-in: The smallest buy-in a player may set; 0 allows free races.

maxBuyIn.description: Highest buy-in: The largest buy-in a player may set; not below the lowest buy-in.

joinSeconds.description: Join time: How long invited drivers have to join; the host can start earlier. A 5 second countdown follows.

maxRacers.description: Racers per race: The most racers one race takes, the host included.

inviteRadius.description: Invitation distance: Drivers this close to the host get the invitation; racers must stay this close (plus 25 m) to the start.

minDistance.description: Shortest race: The straight-line distance from the start to the waypoint must be at least this.

maxMinutes.description: Time limit: A race nobody finishes in this time ends and the pot is split between the racers still in it.

alertChance.description: Alert chance: The chance that a race start sends a police alert at the start line; 0 never alerts.
